def changed():
    prev = previous_frame.segmentation['nodes']; cur = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
    def sig(nodes):
        d={}
        for n in nodes:
            r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']); r1=max(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
            c0=min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']); c1=max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
            d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((n['pixels'],(r0,c0,r1,c1)))
        return d
    p,c = sig(prev), sig(cur)
    return [(k,p.get(k),c.get(k)) for k in set(p)|set(c) if p.get(k)!=c.get(k)]

d = changed()
print('T1 (rdot->plus):', 'NO CHANGE' if not d else d)
if not d:
    res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':10,'col':29},{'action':'MOUSE','row':10,'col':52}])
    d = changed()
    print('T2 (body->plus):', 'NO CHANGE' if not d else d)
</parameter>
</function>
